title: Offer App Shortcuts for your app’s most common and important tasks

statement.en: Make app Shortcuts for your app’s most common and important tasks available when applicable.
statement.ja: 必要な場合にApp Shortcuts for your app’s most common and important tasksを利用可能にする。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable App Shortcuts experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
